As a Forward Deployed Engineer at MarvelX, you'll own customer delivery end-to-end, from post-signature through production and expansion, and you'll build the integration yourself.

Identify expansion opportunities through delivery; feed learnings back into Product, Engineering, and GTM.

An engineer who moved toward customers, or a delivery operator who never stopped building. You write and ship code (Python or TypeScript, APIs, integrations) and you run a boardroom-quality meeting, both, genuinely.
4+ years across software delivery, solutions or forward-deployed engineering, or technical implementation of B2B platforms.
AI-native: you use LLMs and agents in your own daily work, and you can explain what an agent decided in business language, no model talk.
Comfortable with senior stakeholders and with ambiguity; your structure shows up live in the conversation, not in a deck afterwards.
Strong ownership mindset: outcomes, not tasks.
Insurance or regulated-industry experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Your code goes live in regulated, real-world production environments, and you see the impact in the customer's numbers.
Direct impact on ARR growth, customer trust, and our path to Series A.
Competitive compensation, equity participation, and meaningful career growth as we scale.

Job Title

Integration manager

Job Description

Vanderlande is the market-leading supplier of logistics automation. More than 600 airports use our baggage-handling systems, including 17 of the world’s top 20. We move over 4 billion pieces of luggage every year. We’ve also installed over 440 passenger security checkpoints in airports across the world. Our integrated, end-to-end solutions will keep airports running smoothly. So whether it’s bag drop, storage, sortation, flight make-up or reclaim – we’ve got it covered. From check-in to boarding, you can be sure of a safe and efficient flow of passengers and their luggage – every time.

Your role

As Integration Manager, you are part of the project leadership team and work closely with the Project Manager and engineering leads. You take ownership of the integration and testing of the full system.

You maintain the system overview while others focus on individual components. You translate functional design into a working solution and lead integration and test activities from start to handover.

You identify risks early and act before they impact delivery. You make clear decisions when trade-offs arise and ensure all parts come together into a system that performs reliably in a real operational environment.

What Do You Do

Own system integration from design to handover
Translate requirements into a working system design.
Define integration strategy, testing, and acceptance.
Identify risks early and drive mitigation.
Lead the test phases and ensure real progress.
Align teams, suppliers, and stakeholders, ensuring clear and effective communication at all levels.
Manage supplier delivery through verification and validation.
Integrate subsystems into existing environments.
Monitor progress and steer decisions.
Ensure a stable, ready-for-operations system at handover.

What You Bring

You have a technical or logistics education, at least at Bachelor level.
Familiarity with customer processes within airport logistics is preferred.
You are familiar with systems engineering processes (requirement management, verification and validation, change management and configuration management)
You build strong, effective partnerships with customers and internal and external suppliers.
You have a proven ability to balance quality, lead time, and cost.
You have well-developed analytical skills, and you think at system level
You have good communication skills in English (written and verbal) and use those to motivate people at all levels and act as a teambuilder.
You’re willing to travel, for about 50% of your time. Travel depends on the project phases.
Because of the environments in which our systems operate, such as airports, a security clearance (VOG and in some cases VGB) can be part of the role.

Your department

The IT & Integration department is part of the business unit Airport Solutions within Vanderlande Industries and is responsible for the system design, testing, and integration of Airport systems worldwide. We are working for European customers like Amsterdam Schiphol Airport, London Heathrow Airport but also for our international customers like Hong Kong International Airport and JFK.

What We Offer

In this challenging and responsible position, you will have the chance to make a significant contribution to industry-leading projects and be connected to our dedicated people and customers. We offer a position in an informal, international and professional working environment with a lot of scope for personal development. By joining our profitable and growing company you will be able to reach your goals and focus on your future.

This position offers a competitive salary range of € 5665 to € 7689 gross per month (excluding 8% holiday allowance). Through exceeding performance expectations, you even have the possibility to grow outside this scale.

On top of your fixed salary you’ll receive the following secondary benefits

40 vacation days (20 statutory days and a flexible budget worth 20 days). 
Flexible working hours. 
A hybrid workplace (40% working from home and 60% in the office). 
A Health & Wellbeing budget worth €300,- per calendar year.
Commuting allowance, including full reimbursement of travel by public transport. 
Working from home allowance. 
Collective pension scheme and discount on additional health insurance. 
On-site company health centres with a gym, physiotherapists and occupational therapists. 
Vanderlande Academy and training facilities to boost your skills. 
A variety in Vanderlande Network communities and initiatives. 
And a great company restaurant and coffee bar with barista.
